title: janus Module
content_markdown: The _"janus"_ module is a C driver for the Janus websocket protocol. It can interact with one or more Janus servers either by issuing commands to them, or by receiving events from them.
overview: The _"janus"_ module is a C driver for the Janus websocket protocol. It can interact with one or more Janus servers either by issuing commands to them, or by receiving events from them.
how_it_works: This driver can be seen as a centralized Janus connection manager. It will connect to each Janus server, establish the connection hanler ID and the clients can be transparent from the connection handler ID point of view, simply passing the desired Janus commands that they want to run.

exported_parameters.name: janus_send_timeout
exported_parameters.description: Time in milliseconds after a Janus WebSocket connection will be closed if it is not available for blocking writing in this interval (and OpenSIPS wants to send something on it).

exported_parameters.name: janus_max_msg_chunks
exported_parameters.description: The maximum number of chunks in which a Janus message is expected to arrive via WebSocket. If a received packet is more fragmented than this, the connection is dropped

exported_parameters.name: janus_cmd_timeout
exported_parameters.description: The maximally allowed duration for the execution of an Janus command. This interval does not include the connect duration.

exported_parameters.name: janus_cmd_polling_itv
exported_parameters.description: The sleep interval used when polling for an Janus command response. Since the value of this parameter imposes a minimal duration for any Janus command, you should run OpenSIPS in debug mode in order to first determine an expected response time for an arbitrary Janus command, then tune this parameter accordingly.

exported_parameters.name: janus_ping_interval
exported_parameters.description: The time interval at which OpenSIPS will do keepalive pinging on the Janus connect

exported_parameters.name: janus_db_url
exported_parameters.description: The DB URL from where OpenSIPS will load the list of Janus connection

exported_parameters.name: janus_db_table
exported_parameters.description: The DB Table from where OpenSIPS will load the list of Janus connection

exported_functions.name: janus_send_request

parameters.name: janus_id
parameters.description: the ID of the janus connection as defined in the databsae.

parameters.name: response_var
parameters.description: a variable which will hold the text result of the Janus command.

return_values.condition: success - the Janus command executed successfully and any output variables were successfully written to. Note that this does not say anything about the nature of the Janus answer (it may well be a "-ERR" type of response)
failure - internal error or the Janus command failed to execute

exported_functions.description:
Run an arbitrary command on an arbitrary Janus socket. The janus_id must be defined in the database

The current OpenSIPS worker will block until an answer from Janus arrives. The timeout for this operation can be controlled via the **janus_cmd_timeout** param.

exported_events.name: E_JANUS_EVENT
exported_events.description: This event is raised when a notification is received from a Janus server.

parameters.name: janus_id
parameters.description: the janus id as defined in the database

parameters.name: janus_url
parameters.description: the janus url as defined in the database

parameters.name: janus_body
parameters.description: full body of the notification received from janus
